words.ex: He was amongst the first to arrive.
words.ex_cn: 他是最早到达的人之一。
words.en: If something is among other things, it is one of them.

words.tr: n. 有价值的人或物；长处；
words.ex: He is an asset to the team because he works hard.
words.ex_cn: 他是个有价值的人，因为他工作努力。
words.en: An asset is something valuable that an individual, corporation, or country owns or controls with the expectation that it will provide a future benefit.

words.tr: n. 自助餐厅；自助食堂；
words.ex: We ate lunch in the school cafeteria.
words.ex_cn: 我们在学校自助餐厅吃午饭。
words.en: A cafeteria is a type of food service location within an institution in which there is little or no waiting staff table service, whether a restaurant or within an institution such as a large office building or school; a school dining location is also referred to as a dining hall or canteen (in British English).

words.ex: The magic show captivates the children.
words.ex_cn: 魔术表演吸引了孩子们。
words.en: If you are captivated by someone or something, you find them fascinating and attractive.

words.ex: The chandelier hangs above the dining table.
words.ex_cn: 吊灯悬挂在餐桌上方。
words.en: A chandelier is a decorative ceiling-mounted light fixture with branches for several light bulbs or candles.

words.ex: Italian cuisine is famous for pasta and pizza.
words.ex_cn: 意大利烹调风格以意大利面和披萨闻名。
words.en: A style or method of cooking, especially as characteristic of a particular country, region, or establishment.

words.ex: I will definitely come to the party.
words.ex_cn: 我肯定会来参加派对。
words.en: without any doubt; certainly

words.ex: Dew forms on the grass in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 早晨露水出现在草地上。
words.en: Dew is small drops of water that form on the ground and other surfaces outside during the night.

words.ex: They dine at 7 every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他们每天晚上七点进餐。
words.en: To dine means to eat dinner.

words.ex: The school values diversity in its students.
words.ex_cn: 学校重视学生的多样性。
words.en: The state of being diverse; variety.

words.tr: adj. 实际的；脚踏实地的
words.ex: He is a down-to-earth man who helps everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个脚踏实地的人，乐于帮助每个人。
words.en: If you say that someone is down-to-earth, you approve of the fact that they concern themselves with practical things and actions, rather than with abstract theories.

words.tr:
v. 遭遇；遇到；邂逅；
n. 遭遇；
words.ex: He encountered a bear while hiking in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 他在森林里徒步时遭遇了一只熊。
words.en: If you encounter problems or difficulties, you experience them.

words.ex: His ethnicity is Chinese.
words.ex_cn: 他的种族渊源是中国。
words.en: Ethnicity is the fact or state of belonging to a social group that has a common national or cultural tradition.

words.ex: He gave an expository speech about how plants grow.
words.ex_cn: 他做了一次关于植物如何生长的说明性演讲。
words.en: Intended to explain or describe something.

words.tr:
v. 过滤；
n. 过滤器；
words.ex: She filters the water before drinking it.
words.ex_cn: 她在喝水之前过滤水。
words.en: A filter is a device or a method that removes unwanted substances from something such as water, air, or light, by passing it through a special material or system.

words.ex: He is a freshman at university.
words.ex_cn: 他是大学的一名新生。
words.en: A freshman is a student in the first year of high school, college, or university.

words.tr:
n. 凝视；注视；
v. 凝视；注视；
words.ex: His gaze fixed on the sunset.
words.ex_cn: 他的凝视固定在日落上。
words.en: If you gaze at someone or something, you look steadily at them for a long time, for example because you find them attractive or interesting, or because you are thinking about something else.

words.ex: She wore a gorgeous dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一件华丽的裙子去参加派对。
words.en: If you say that something is gorgeous, you mean that it gives you a lot of pleasure or is very attractive.

words.tr:
v. 突出；强调；高光；
n. 最突出的部分；
words.ex: The teacher highlighted the key words in the text.
words.ex_cn: 老师把文中的关键词突出了。
words.en: To highlight something means to make it stand out or to emphasize it, often because it is important or interesting.

words.tr: adj. 有历史意义的；历史性的；
words.ex: This is a historic moment for our country.
words.ex_cn: 这是对我们国家有历史意义的时刻。
words.en: Something that is historic is important in history, or potentially so.

words.ex: The lamp illuminate the dark room.
words.ex_cn: 这盏灯照亮了黑暗的房间。
words.en: To illuminate something means to shine light on it and to make it brighter and more visible.

words.tr: adv. 无可挑剔地；无瑕疵地
words.ex: She dressed impeccably for the occasion.
words.ex_cn: 她为这个场合打扮得无可挑剔。
words.en: In a manner that is flawless or without fault.

words.ex: The movie was incredible.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影太棒了。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as incredible, you like them very much or are impressed by them, because they are extremely or unusually good.

words.ex: The project involves simple math and writing.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目包括简单的数学和写作。
words.en: If a situation or activity involves something, that thing is a necessary part or consequence of it.

words.tr: adj. 高的；崇高的；傲慢的
words.ex: The mountain has a lofty peak.
words.ex_cn: 这座山有一个很高的山顶。
words.en: If you say that someone behaves in a lofty way, you are critical of them for behaving in a proud and rather unpleasant way, as if they think they are very important.

words.tr: adj. 强制的；法定的；义务的；
words.ex: Wearing a helmet is mandatory for cyclists.
words.ex_cn: 骑自行车时戴头盔是强制的。
words.en: If something is mandatory, it is required by law or by a rule or regulation.

words.ex: He likes reading books; moreover, he writes his own stories.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢读书；此外，他还写自己的故事。
words.en: You use moreover to introduce a piece of information that adds to or supports the previous statement.

words.tr:
adj. 音乐的；擅长音乐的；
n. 音乐剧；音乐歌舞片；
words.ex: He loves musical songs.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢音乐的歌曲。
words.en: Relating to music; having the pleasant sound of music.

words.ex: He painted a portrait of his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他画了一幅他母亲的肖像。
words.en: A portrait is a painting, drawing, or photograph of a particular person.

words.ex: His words had a profound effect on her life.
words.ex_cn: 他的话对她的生活产生了深远的影响。
words.en: If you describe something as profound, you mean that it is very great or intense.

words.ex: The publication of his book was delayed.
words.ex_cn: 他的书的出版被推迟了。
words.en: The act of making something available to the public, especially a book, magazine, or newspaper.

words.tr: adj. 不同寻常的；非凡的；显著的；值得注意的；
words.ex: She made a remarkable improvement in just one month.
words.ex_cn: 她在短短一个月内取得了不同寻常的进步。
words.en: Unusual or striking in a way that attracts attention.

words.tr:
n. 样品；样本；
v. 抽样；
words.ex: The scientist tested the sample from the river.
words.ex_cn: 科学家测试了来自河流的样品。
words.en: A sample is a small quantity of a product, especially food, given to customers so that they can try it before buying it.

words.ex: The sun shines through the skylight.
words.ex_cn: 阳光透过天窗照进来。
words.en: A skylight is a window set into a roof or ceiling to allow daylight to enter a building.

words.tr: adj. 单独的；独唱的；独奏的；
words.ex: He played a solo guitar piece at the concert.
words.ex_cn: 他在音乐会上演奏了一首独奏吉他曲。
words.en: A solo is a piece of music or a performance done by one person alone, without any accompaniment.

words.tr:
n. 闪光；闪烁；活力
v. 闪光；焕发活力
words.ex: The diamond showed a tiny sparkle in the sunlight.
words.ex_cn: 钻石在阳光下显示出一丝闪光。
words.en: If something sparkles, it shines brightly with a lot of small points of light.

words.tr:
n. 污点；
v. 玷污；
words.ex: There is a coffee stain on the table.
words.ex_cn: 桌子上有一个咖啡污点。
words.en: A stain is a mark on something that is difficult to remove, especially one made by a liquid such as blood or coffee. To stain something means to leave a mark on it that is difficult to remove.

words.ex: There is a big statue in the city center.
words.ex_cn: 城市中心有一座巨大的雕像。
words.en: A statue is a large sculpture of a person or an animal, made of stone or metal.

words.ex: They booked a hotel suite for their honeymoon.
words.ex_cn: 他们为蜜月预订了一间酒店套房。
words.en: A set of rooms designated for use together, especially in a hotel; a set of musical compositions designed to be performed in a sequence.

words.ex: The trees surround the house.
words.ex_cn: 树木环绕着房子。
words.en: If something or someone is surrounded by something, that thing is situated all around them.

words.tr: adj. 艰苦的；强硬的；严厉的；
words.ex: The hike was tough but beautiful.
words.ex_cn: 这次徒步旅行很艰苦但很美丽。
words.en: A tough person is strong and determined, and can tolerate difficulty or suffering.

words.ex: He worked hard, and ultimately succeeded.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作，最终成功了。
words.en: You use ultimately to indicate that something is the final result of a series of events or the most important part of a situation.

words.ex: The city lights shone vibrantly against the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 城市灯光在夜空中闪耀着活力。
words.en: In a manner that is full of energy and life; brightly.

words.ex: The room is filled with laughter.
words.ex_cn: 房间里充满了笑声。
words.en: To have a lot of a particular quality or thing.

words.ex: My mom is proud of me because I passed the test.
words.ex_cn: 我妈妈为我通过考试而感到骄傲。
words.en: To feel a sense of pride or satisfaction in something or someone.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 彻底击败；使印象深刻；吹走
words.ex: The champion blew away all his opponents in the final match.
words.ex_cn: 冠军在决赛中彻底击败了所有对手。
words.en: To remove something by blowing, or to cause someone to be very surprised.

words.ex: He got involved in the school play last month.
words.ex_cn: 他上个月参加了学校的戏剧表演。
words.en: To become a part of or participate in an activity or situation.

words.tr: phrase. 就...而言；在...方面；根据
words.ex: In terms of cost, this phone is cheaper.
words.ex_cn: 从成本来看，这部手机更便宜。
words.en: used to indicate what aspect of a subject you are talking about

words.ex: They move into a new house next week.
words.ex_cn: 他们下周搬进新房子。
words.en: To begin living in a new home or place.

words.tr: phrase. 结果却；不料反而（表示出乎意料的后续结果）
words.ex: He ran to the bus stop, only to miss the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他跑到公交车站，结果却错过了公交车。
words.en: Used to indicate an unexpected or disappointing result of an action.

words.ex: He will share his lunch with his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他将和朋友分享他的午餐。
words.en: To have a mutual experience or use of something with another person.

words.tr: phrase. 选修一门课程；参加一个课程
words.ex: She decided to take a course in digital marketing to enhance her skills.
words.ex_cn: 她决定参加一门数字营销课程以提升自己的技能。
words.en: To enroll in and attend a series of classes or lessons in a particular subject.

words.ex: He thinks to himself, 'I can do this.'
words.ex_cn: 他心里想：‘我能行。’
words.en: To consider something in one's mind without expressing it aloud.

words.ex: The two houses are apart by fifty meters.
words.ex_cn: 这两所房子相隔五十米。
words.en: If people or things are apart, they are separated by a distance.

words.ex: He wants to apply for a job at the bank.
words.ex_cn: 他想申请银行的工作。
words.en: To make a formal request, usually in writing, for something such as a job, a place at a university, or permission to do something.

words.ex: There was an array of people at the concert.
words.ex_cn: 音乐会上人山人海。
words.en: An array of different things or people is a large number or wide range of them.

words.ex: He avoids eating sugar to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他避免吃糖以保持健康。
words.en: If you avoid something, you take action in order to prevent it from happening to you.

words.ex: His behavior at the party was very polite.
words.ex_cn: 他在派对上的举止非常礼貌。
words.en: The way in which one acts or conducts oneself, especially towards others.

words.tr: adv. 令人困惑地；使人迷乱地
words.ex: The instructions were bewilderingly complex.
words.ex_cn: 这些说明复杂得令人困惑。
words.en: In a manner that causes someone to become perplexed and confused.

words.tr:
adj. 空白的；
n. 空白处；
words.ex: The paper had a blank space at the top.
words.ex_cn: 这张纸的顶部有一个空白区域。
words.en: If something is blank, it has nothing on it.

words.tr: adj. 无聊的；烦闷的；厌倦的； v. 钻孔；“bore”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He felt bored during the long meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在漫长的会议中感到无聊。
words.en: If you are bored, you feel tired and impatient because you have lost interest in something or because you have nothing to do.

words.ex: He bought a brand-new bike.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一辆全新的自行车。
words.en: Completely new, as if recently made or acquired.

words.ex: I like to browse the internet for fun.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢上网浏览消遣。
words.en: To look through or glance at reading matter casually or randomly.

words.ex: The charity helps poor children get food and education.
words.ex_cn: 这个慈善团体帮助贫困儿童获得食物和教育。
words.en: An organization that helps people in need, or the act of giving money, food, or help to those who need it.

words.ex: The teacher gave a comprehensive review before the exam.
words.ex_cn: 老师在考试前给了一个全面的复习。
words.en: Something that is comprehensive includes everything that is needed or relevant.

words.tr:
n. 绝望；
v. 绝望；
words.ex: He felt despair after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业后感到绝望。
words.en: Despair is the feeling that everything is wrong and that nothing will improve.

words.ex: I looked up his phone number in the directory.
words.ex_cn: 我在姓名地址录里查了他的电话号码。
words.en: A directory is a book or list which gives names, addresses, and other information about people or organizations.

words.ex: The downside of this job is the long hours.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作的负面是工作时间很长。
words.en: The downside of something is the aspect of it which is less positive, pleasant, or useful than its other aspects.

words.ex: He loves watching drama on TV.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在电视上看戏剧。
words.en: A drama is a serious play for the theatre, television, or radio, or a serious style of acting intended to represent real life and characters.

words.tr:
adj. 不拘一格的；兼收并蓄的；折中的
n. 折中主义者
words.ex: He has an eclectic taste in music.
words.ex_cn: 他对音乐的品味很广泛多样。
words.en: An eclectic collection or group is a wide range of different things or people.

words.ex: This book has three editions.
words.ex_cn: 这本书有三个版次。
words.en: An edition is a particular version of a book, magazine, or newspaper that is printed at one time.

words.tr: v. 繁荣兴旺；茁壮成长；
words.ex: The business flourishes in the new market.
words.ex_cn: 这家企业在新市场中繁荣兴旺。
words.en: If something flourishes, it is successful, active, or common, and developing quickly and strongly.

words.tr:
n. 大学一年级新生；新鲜人
adj. 新鲜的；“fresh”的比较级
words.ex: He is a fresher at Oxford University.
words.ex_cn: 他是牛津大学的一年级新生。
words.en: A fresher is a student in their first year at a university or college.

words.tr:
n. 补助金；授予物；
v. 承认；授予；允许；
words.ex: The university received a grant for scientific research.
words.ex_cn: 这所大学收到了一笔用于科学研究的补助金。
words.en: If someone in authority grants you something, or if something is granted to you, you are allowed to have it or do it.

words.tr: v. 劈砍；侵入（计算机等）
words.ex: He hacked the tree with an axe.
words.ex_cn: 他用斧头劈砍那棵树。
words.en: To hack means to cut or chop something with rough or heavy blows, or to gain unauthorized access to data in a system or computer.

words.tr: n. 牛车；双轮牛车；粗劣作品；新闻行业
words.ex: The old hackery creaked as it moved slowly down the dirt road.
words.ex_cn: 旧牛车在土路上缓慢移动时嘎吱作响。
words.en: The use of computers to gain unauthorized access to data in a system.

words.ex: He is highly talented.
words.ex_cn: 他非常有才华。
words.en: to a high degree or level; very

words.ex: He immersed the cloth in water.
words.ex_cn: 他把布浸在水里。
words.en: To immerse something or someone means to put them into a liquid so that they are completely covered by it. It can also mean to involve oneself deeply in a particular activity or interest.

words.tr: adj. 不可避免的；必定的；
words.ex: It is inevitable that the sun will rise tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 太阳明天一定会升起。
words.en: If something is inevitable, it is certain to happen and cannot be prevented or avoided.

words.ex: He reads books in his leisure.
words.ex_cn: 他在空闲时间读书。
words.en: Leisure is the time when you are not working and you can relax and do things that you enjoy.

words.ex: He loves reading English literature.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢阅读英语文学。
words.en: Literature consists of written works, especially those considered to have artistic or intellectual value.

words.ex: The bank gave a loan to the student.
words.ex_cn: 银行向学生提供了一笔贷款。
words.en: A loan is a sum of money that you borrow.

words.ex: The birds mate in spring.
words.ex_cn: 这些鸟在春天交配。
words.en: A mate is a friend, someone you work with, or someone you are married to or in a sexual relationship with. As a verb, to mate means to have sex in order to produce young or to bring two animals together for breeding.

words.tr: adj. 负面的；消极的；否定的；
words.ex: The news had a negative effect on the market.
words.ex_cn: 这条新闻对市场产生了负面影响。
words.en: If someone is negative or has a negative attitude, they consider only the bad aspects of a situation, rather than the good ones.

words.ex: The proctor watched students during the exam.
words.ex_cn: 学监在考试期间监视学生。
words.en: A proctor is someone who supervises students during an examination to ensure that the rules are obeyed.

words.ex: This region has many mountains.
words.ex_cn: 这个地区有很多山。
words.en: A region is a large area of land that is different from other areas of land, for example because it is one of the different parts of a country with its own customs and characteristics, or because it has a particular geographical feature.

words.tr:
v. 注册；登记；
n. 登记簿；
words.ex: He will register for the course next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周会注册这门课程。
words.en: If you register something, you officially record it or list it.

words.ex: He practices his religion every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周日都实践自己的宗教信仰。
words.en: Religion is the belief in and worship of a superhuman controlling power, especially a personal God or gods.

words.ex: He loves reading sci-fi about space travel.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢读关于太空旅行的科幻小说。
words.en: Science fiction, often called sci-fi, is a genre of speculative fiction that typically deals with imaginative and futuristic concepts such as advanced science and technology, space exploration, time travel, parallel universes, and extraterrestrial life.

words.tr:
v. （使）获得；
adj. 安全的；稳定的；
words.ex: He worked hard to secure a job.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以获得一份工作。
words.en: If you secure something that you want or need, you obtain it, often after a lot of effort.

words.ex: He seeks help when he is stuck.
words.ex_cn: 当他遇到困难时，他会寻求帮助。
words.en: If you seek something, you try to find it or obtain it.

words.tr:
n. 火花；火星；
v. 激发；
words.ex: The match produced a small spark.
words.ex_cn: 火柴产生了一个小火花。
words.en: A spark is a small fiery particle thrown off from a fire, alight in ashes, or produced by striking together two hard surfaces such as stone or metal.

words.ex: Children tend to be more active in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 孩子往往在早上更活跃。
words.en: If someone tends to do something, they usually do it or they often do it.

words.tr: v. 兴旺；繁荣；茁壮成长；
words.ex: Plants thrive in sunny places.
words.ex_cn: 植物在阳光充足的地方茁壮成长。
words.en: To thrive means to grow or develop well or vigorously.

words.ex: The two countries formed a union to strengthen trade.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家组成了一个联盟以加强贸易。
words.en: An organization of workers formed to protect their rights and interests; the act of joining two or more things together.

words.ex: He did voluntary work at the hospital.
words.ex_cn: 他在医院做志愿工作。
words.en: If something is voluntary, you do it because you choose to, and not because you have to.

words.ex: He lives apart from the city noise.
words.ex_cn: 他住在远离城市喧嚣的地方。
words.en: You use apart from when you are making an exception to a general statement.

words.ex: We checked out of the hotel after paying the bill.
words.ex_cn: 我们付完账后离开了酒店。
words.en: To check out means to leave a hotel after paying your bill, or to examine something or someone in order to be certain that everything is correct, safe, or satisfactory.

words.tr: phrase. 分发；发出；发表；用尽
words.ex: He gives out books to the students.
words.ex_cn: 他把书分发给学生们。
words.en: To distribute or hand out something; to emit or produce something such as a sound or smell; to announce or make something known publicly.

words.tr: phrase. 闲逛；常去某处；挂出
words.ex: They hang out at the park after school.
words.ex_cn: 他们放学后在公园闲逛。
words.en: To spend time idly or casually, often with others.

words.tr: phrase. 使自己沉浸于；专心于；埋头于
words.ex: He likes to immerse himself in simple books every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢每天晚上沉浸在简单的书籍中。
words.en: To involve oneself deeply in a particular activity or interest.

words.tr: phrase. 确切指出（问题、原因等）；准确识别
words.ex: I can't put my finger on the problem, but something feels wrong.
words.ex_cn: 我无法指出问题所在，但感觉有些不对劲。
words.en: To identify or describe something exactly.

words.tr: phrase. 投身于；全心投入（某活动或事业）
words.ex: He threw himself into learning English.
words.ex_cn: 他全身心投入到英语学习中。
words.en: To start doing something with a lot of energy and enthusiasm.

words.ex: He has the capacity to solve hard math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他有能力解决复杂的数学问题。
words.en: The capacity of a place or container is the amount of things or people that it can hold.

words.tr:
v. 声称；索赔；
n. 声称；索要；
words.ex: He claims that he saw a UFO last night.
words.ex_cn: 他声称自己昨晚看到了不明飞行物。
words.en: If you say that someone claims that something is true, you mean they say that it is true but you are not sure whether or not they are telling the truth.

words.ex: He deluded himself into thinking he would win.
words.ex_cn: 他欺骗自己，以为自己会赢。
words.en: If you delude yourself, you let yourself believe that something is true, even though it is not true.

words.tr:
n. 纪律；学科；科目；训练；惩戒；
v. 约束自己；
words.ex: The teacher enforced discipline in the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 老师在教室里维持纪律。
words.en: Discipline is the practice of making people obey rules or standards of behaviour, and punishing them when they do not.

words.ex: He dominates the conversation.
words.ex_cn: 他主宰了谈话。
words.en: To dominate means to control or govern someone or something, or to be the most important or noticeable feature of something.

words.ex: He wants to study engineering at university.
words.ex_cn: 他想在大学学习工程。
words.en: Engineering is the work involved in designing and constructing engines and machinery, or structures such as roads and bridges. Engineering is also the subject studied by people who want to do this work.

words.ex: The elephant is enormous.
words.ex_cn: 这头大象非常巨大。
words.en: If you describe something as enormous, you are emphasizing that it is extremely large in size or amount.

words.tr: n. 人性；人类；人道；仁慈；
words.ex: Kindness shows the best of humanity.
words.ex_cn: 善良展现了人性中最美好的一面。
words.en: Humanity refers to all human beings collectively or the qualities that make us human, such as kindness, compassion, and the ability to reason.

words.tr: adj. 卑微的；谦逊的；虚心的；
words.ex: He lived in a humble house near the river.
words.ex_cn: 他住在河边一座简陋的房子里。
words.en: If you describe someone as humble, you mean that they do not think they are better or more important than other people.

words.tr: v. 把…强加给；使遭受；使承受
words.ex: The storm inflicted heavy damage on the village.
words.ex_cn: 风暴给村庄造成了严重破坏。
words.en: If you inflict something unpleasant on someone, you make them suffer it.

words.tr: n. 奢华；奢侈品；难得的享受；
words.ex: She bought a luxury dress for the party.
words.ex_cn: 她为派对买了一件奢华的裙子。
words.en: Luxury is very great comfort, especially among beautiful and expensive surroundings.

words.ex: The philosopher wrote a book about life.
words.ex_cn: 这位哲学家写了一本关于生活的书。
words.en: A philosopher is a person who studies or writes about philosophy.

words.ex: He likes to study philosophy in his free time.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在空闲时间学习哲学。
words.en: Philosophy is the study or creation of theories about basic things such as the nature of existence, knowledge, and thought, or about how people should live.

words.tr:
n. 音高；球场；程度（最高点）；宣传论点；
v. 扎营；
words.ex: The singer changed the pitch of her voice.
words.ex_cn: 歌手改变了她声音的音高。
words.en: Pitch can refer to the highness or lowness of a sound, the act of throwing something, or a thick, black, sticky substance used for paving roads or waterproofing.

words.tr: adj. 自负的；自命不凡的；浮华的
words.ex: He gave a pompous speech with big words.
words.ex_cn: 他用华丽的词藻做了一番自大的演讲。
words.en: If you describe someone as pompous, you mean that they behave or speak in a very serious way because they think they are more important than they really are.

words.ex: He showed skepticism about the new claim.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个新说法持怀疑态度。
words.en: Skepticism is a questioning attitude or doubt towards one or more items of putative knowledge or belief.

words.tr:
n. 傻笑；假笑
v. 傻笑；自鸣得意地笑
words.ex: He gave a smirk when he won the game.
words.ex_cn: 他赢了比赛时露出了冷笑。
words.en: A smirk is a smile expressing smugness or scorn instead of pleasure.

words.tr: n. 来源；出处；源泉；源头；提供资料者；
words.ex: The river's source is in the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 这条河的源头在山里。
words.en: The place, person, or thing from which something comes or can be obtained.

words.tr:
adj. 颠覆性的；破坏性的
n. 颠覆分子；危险分子
words.ex: The subversive poster tried to break the government's rules.
words.ex_cn: 那张颠覆性的海报试图破坏政府的规则。
words.en: A subversive person or activity is one that is intended to weaken or destroy a political system or government.

words.ex: The teacher gave us the syllabus for the course.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我们这门课的教学大纲。
words.en: A syllabus is an outline or summary of the main points of a text, lecture, or course of study.

words.tr: v. 逐渐削弱；暗中损害；
words.ex: Constant criticism can undermine your confidence.
words.ex_cn: 不断的批评会逐渐削弱你的信心。
words.en: To undermine something means to weaken it or make it less effective, often in a gradual or sneaky way.

words.ex: He is a well-rounded student who likes sports, music, and math.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个全面发展的好学生，喜欢运动、音乐和数学。
words.en: If you describe someone as well-rounded, you mean that they have a personality which is fully developed in all aspects.

words.ex: The point of this game is to learn quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这个游戏的重点是快速学习。
words.en: The main idea or purpose of something.

words.ex: I need a couple of minutes to finish this.
words.ex_cn: 我需要几分钟来完成这个。
words.en: A couple of is used to refer to a small number of things or people, usually two or a few more than two.

words.tr: phrase. 使遭受（痛苦、损失等）；把…强加于
words.ex: He will inflict the punishment on the boy.
words.ex_cn: 他将把惩罚施加在那个男孩身上。
words.en: If you inflict something unpleasant or harmful on someone, you make them suffer it.

words.tr: phrase. 在某种程度上；部分地
words.ex: He succeeded in part because he worked hard.
words.ex_cn: 他部分成功是因为他努力工作。
words.en: To some extent; not completely.

words.tr: phrase. 副作用；附带产生的后果
words.ex: Feeling tired is a side effect of the medicine.
words.ex_cn: 感到疲倦是这种药物的副作用。
words.en: An unintended and often undesirable consequence of an action or treatment.

words.ex: He is an astrophysicist who studies stars.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名研究恒星的天体物理学家。
words.en: An astrophysicist is a scientist who studies the physical properties and processes of celestial objects and phenomena.

words.ex: He built a successful career in medicine.
words.ex_cn: 他在医学领域建立了成功的事业。
words.en: A career is the job or series of jobs that you do during your working life, especially if you continue to get better jobs and earn more money.

words.ex: He computes the total cost quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快算出总成本。
words.en: If you compute a total, amount, or result, you calculate it.

words.ex: Farmers cultivate rice in the fields.
words.ex_cn: 农民在田里种植水稻。
words.en: To cultivate land means to prepare it and grow crops on it. To cultivate a particular quality, skill, or attitude means to try hard to develop it and make it stronger.

words.ex: The child's curiosity made him ask many questions.
words.ex_cn: 孩子的好奇心让他问了很多问题。
words.en: A desire to know or learn about something; something that is interesting because it is unusual or strange.

words.ex: He noticed every detail of the painting.
words.ex_cn: 他注意到了这幅画的每一个细节。
words.en: A detail is a small individual feature or element of something.

words.ex: He bought a new device to take photos.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一个新设备来拍照。
words.en: A device is an object or machine that has been invented for a particular purpose.

words.tr: v. 移情；神会；有同感；产生共鸣
words.ex: She tries to empathize with her friend's feelings.
words.ex_cn: 她努力理解朋友的感受。
words.en: If you empathize with someone, you understand their situation, problems, and feelings, because you have been in a similar situation.

words.ex: She showed empathy when her friend cried.
words.ex_cn: 当她的朋友哭泣时，她表现出了同感。
words.en: The ability to understand and share the feelings of another.

words.ex: The magic show had a strange fascination for children.
words.ex_cn: 魔术表演对孩子们有一种奇特的迷惑力。
words.en: A fascination is a very strong interest or attraction for someone or something.

words.ex: He can identify the bird by its song.
words.ex_cn: 他能通过鸟的叫声识别它。
words.en: If you can identify someone or something, you are able to recognize them or distinguish them from others.

words.ex: The company values innovation in its products.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司重视产品的创新。
words.en: Innovation is the introduction of new ideas, methods, or things.

words.ex: His insight helped the team solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他的洞察力帮助团队解决了问题。
words.en: If you gain insight or an insight into a complex situation or problem, you gain an accurate and deep understanding of it.

words.tr:
v. 屠杀 
n. 大屠杀
words.ex: The soldiers committed a massacre in the village.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们在村庄里进行了大屠杀。
words.en: The indiscriminate killing of a large number of people.

words.ex: Good teachers motivate students to learn.
words.ex_cn: 好老师激励学生学习。
words.en: To motivate someone means to provide them with a reason for doing something, especially something that requires effort.

words.tr:
n. 笔记；便条；音调；注释；语气；
v. 注意；记录；
words.ex: I took notes during the lecture.
words.ex_cn: 我在讲座期间做了笔记。
words.en: A note is a short piece of writing, a musical sound, or a piece of paper money. It can also mean to pay attention to something or to write something down.

words.ex: He has a passion for painting.
words.ex_cn: 他对绘画充满激情。
words.en: A very strong feeling of love, hate, anger, enthusiasm, etc.

words.ex: He wants to pursue his dream of becoming a writer.
words.ex_cn: 他想追求成为作家的梦想。
words.en: If you pursue an activity, interest, or plan, you carry it out or follow it.

words.ex: He is the recipient of the prize.
words.ex_cn: 他是这个奖项的接受者。
words.en: A recipient is a person who receives something.

words.tr:
v. 屠宰；屠杀
n. 屠宰；屠杀
words.ex: Farmers slaughter pigs for meat.
words.ex_cn: 农民宰猪取肉。
words.en: The killing of animals for food; the killing of a large number of people in a cruel or violent way.

words.ex: He is a sophomore at Harvard University.
words.ex_cn: 他是哈佛大学的二年级学生。
words.en: A sophomore is a student in the second year of college or high school.

words.tr:
n. 阶段；时期；舞台；
v. 举行；上演；
words.ex: This is a critical stage in his recovery.
words.ex_cn: 这是他康复过程中的一个关键阶段。
words.en: A stage is a raised area in a theatre or hall where performers, speakers, or entertainers stand. It can also refer to a particular point or period in the development or progress of something.

words.ex: He made a strategic decision to save money.
words.ex_cn: 他做出了一个有战略性的决定来省钱。
words.en: Relating to the identification of long-term or overall aims and interests and the means of achieving them.

words.tr:
n. 表面；
v. 显露；
words.ex: The surface of the table is smooth.
words.ex_cn: 桌子的表面很光滑。
words.en: The outer or top part of something; to rise to the surface of water or to become known after being hidden or secret.

words.tr:
v. 转移；转让；调任；
n. 转移；转让；调任；
words.ex: He will transfer the money to his bank account.
words.ex_cn: 他将把钱转到他的银行账户。
words.en: If you transfer something or someone from one place to another, or they transfer from one place to another, they go from the first place to the second.

words.ex: Her talent trumped his experience.
words.ex_cn: 她的才华胜过了他的经验。
words.en: In card games, a trump is a card of a suit which has been chosen to rank above the other suits. As a verb, to trump means to beat someone or something by doing or producing something better.

words.tr: 短语动词. 充分利用；从……中获得最大收益
words.ex: To get the most out of your study time, create a detailed plan.
words.ex_cn: 为了充分利用你的学习时间，制定一个详细的计划。
words.en: To use something in such a way as to obtain the maximum benefit or advantage from it.

words.tr: phrase. 重视；认为…重要；把重点放在…上
words.ex: They place importance on good education.
words.ex_cn: 他们重视良好教育。
words.en: To consider something as very important.

words.tr: 短语. 一批；一群；一具（尸体）；指聚集在一起的人或物，常用于表示有组织的整体，如 'a body of knowledge'（一批知识）或 'a body of water'（一片水域）
words.ex: He wrote a body of work on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他撰写了一系列关于气候变化的作品。
words.en: A large group or organization of people with a shared purpose or function.

words.tr: phrase. v. 度过难关；勉强应付；勉强维持生活
words.ex: He gets by with little money.
words.ex_cn: 他靠很少的钱维持生活。
words.en: To manage to live or do a particular thing using the money, knowledge, equipment, etc. that you have.

words.ex: A host of students came to the lecture.
words.ex_cn: 许多学生来听讲座了。
words.en: A large number of something.

words.tr:
n. 挑战；
v. 提出挑战；
words.ex: Climbing that mountain is a big challenge.
words.ex_cn: 爬那座山是一个巨大的挑战。
words.en: A challenge is something new and difficult which requires great effort and determination.

words.tr: n. 开始；毕业典礼；学位授予典礼
words.ex: The commencement of the class was at 9 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 课程的开始时间是上午9点。
words.en: The commencement of something is its beginning.

words.ex: The community cleaned the park together.
words.ex_cn: 社区居民一起清理了公园。
words.en: A community is a group of people who live in the same area or who have the same interests, religion, or nationality.

words.tr: adj. 抑郁的； v. 降低；“depress”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He felt depressed after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业后感到抑郁。
words.en: If you are depressed, you are sad and feel that you cannot enjoy anything, because your situation is so difficult and unpleasant.

words.ex: The student was sent to detention for breaking the rules.
words.ex_cn: 这名学生因违反规则被留校滞留。
words.en: Detention is the act of detaining someone or the state of being detained in official custody, especially as a political prisoner.

words.ex: The cable is disconnected from the computer.
words.ex_cn: 这条线缆从电脑上断开了。
words.en: If something is disconnected, it is not joined to anything else or is not in contact with anything else.

words.ex: The faculty of engineering has many labs.
words.ex_cn: 工程学院有许多实验室。
words.en: A faculty is a group of departments in a university or college that specialize in a particular subject or group of subjects, or the teachers in such a group.

words.tr:
adj. 磨损的；焦虑的
v. （使）磨损；（使）烦躁；（使）紧张；“fray”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: The edges of the carpet have become frayed over time.
words.ex_cn: 地毯的边缘随着时间的推移已经磨损了。
words.en: If something is frayed, its edges are worn away, often because it has been used a lot.

words.tr:
n. 荣誉；荣幸；尊敬；
v. 尊敬；给予荣誉；履行；
words.ex: He received an honor for his brave actions.
words.ex_cn: 他因勇敢的行为获得了荣誉。
words.en: Honor is a quality that combines respect, pride, and honesty. A person who has honor is someone who is admired and respected because of his or her integrity and ethical behavior.

words.tr:
n. 影响力；冲击（力）；
v. 对…产生影响；
words.ex: The new law had a big impact on education.
words.ex_cn: 这项新法律对教育产生了重大影响。
words.en: The effect or influence of one person, thing, or action, on another.

words.tr: n. 冒名顶替者；冒名行骗者
words.ex: She felt like an imposter in her own life.
words.ex_cn: 她觉得自己在生活中像个冒名顶替者。
words.en: An imposter is someone who pretends to be someone else in order to deceive others, especially for fraudulent gain.

words.ex: She instinctively reached for her phone when it rang.
words.ex_cn: 电话响时，她下意识地伸手去拿手机。
words.en: If you behave instinctively, you do something without thinking about it because it seems natural or the right thing to do.

words.ex: The janitor cleans the school every night.
words.ex_cn: 门卫每天晚上打扫学校。
words.en: A janitor is a person whose job is to take care of a building, especially by cleaning it.

words.tr:
adj. 青少年的；幼稚的；
n. 少年；
words.ex: The book is written for juvenile readers.
words.ex_cn: 这本书是为青少年读者撰写的。
words.en: A juvenile is a child or young person who is not yet old enough to be considered an adult.

words.tr:
v. 发射；发起；启动；
n. 发射；投掷；启动；
words.ex: They will launch a rocket tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他们明天将发射一枚火箭。
words.en: To launch something means to send it into the air, space, or water, especially with a lot of force or effort, or to start an activity, event, or project.

words.tr: n. 会员资格；全体会员；
words.ex: He paid $50 to get membership of the gym.
words.ex_cn: 他支付了50美元以获得健身房的会员资格。
words.en: Membership is the state of being a member of a group or organization.

words.tr:
adj. 一千年的
n. 千禧世代
words.ex: Millennial workers prefer flexible hours.
words.ex_cn: 千禧一代的员工更喜欢灵活的工作时间。
words.en: Relating to a millennium or the millennials, the generation of people born between the early 1980s and the late 1990s.

words.tr: n. 鸦片样物质，类鸦片; adj. 类鸦片的
words.ex: The opioid crisis has led to increased awareness of addiction.
words.ex_cn: 类鸦片危机增加了人们对成瘾问题的认识。
words.en: Opioids are a class of drugs that include the illegal drug heroin, synthetic opioids such as fentanyl, and pain relievers available legally by prescription, such as oxycodone (OxyContin), hydrocodone (Vicodin), codeine, morphine, and many others.

words.tr: adj. 再次发生的；再次兴起的；更新的； v. 更新；“renew”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The conflict was renewed after the peace talks failed.
words.ex_cn: 和平谈判失败后，冲突再次发生。
words.en: If something is renewed, it is made new again or replaced so that it is like new.

words.ex: The school needs more resources for students.
words.ex_cn: 学校需要为学生提供更多的资源。
words.en: A resource is a source or supply from which benefit is produced. Typically resources are materials, energy, services, staff, knowledge, or other assets that are transformed to produce benefit and in the process may be consumed or made unavailable.

words.ex: He responded to the question quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快回答了问题。
words.en: If you respond to something that is done or said, you react to it by doing or saying something yourself.

words.ex: The void on the page made the text look empty.
words.ex_cn: 页面上的空白让文字看起来空荡荡的。
words.en: If you describe a situation or a feeling as a void, you mean that it seems empty because there is nothing interesting or worthwhile about it.

words.tr: phrase. 可归结为；屈尊做某事
words.ex: It will come down to who works harder.
words.ex_cn: 这将取决于谁更努力。
words.en: If a problem, decision, or question comes down to a particular thing, that thing is the most important factor involved.

words.tr: phrase. 通过；（电话）打通；度过；做完；用完
words.ex: He got through the exam with help from his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他在朋友的帮助下通过了考试。
words.en: To succeed in reaching a place or a stage in a process, or to make someone understand or accept something.

words.ex: It did not occur to him to call for help.
words.ex_cn: 他没想到要打电话求助。
words.en: If a thought or idea occurs to you, it comes into your mind.

words.tr: phrase. 撕开；使分裂；使崩溃；严厉批评
words.ex: The dog will tear apart the toy if you give it to him.
words.ex_cn: 如果你把玩具给他，狗会把它撕成碎片。
words.en: To tear something apart means to destroy it by pulling it to pieces, or to cause great emotional pain to someone.

words.tr: phrase. 出现；生产；结果是；关闭；朝外
words.ex: The weather turned out to be sunny.
words.ex_cn: 天气结果是晴朗的。
words.en: If something turns out a particular way, it happens in that way or has the result or degree of success indicated. If you turn out something, you produce or create it. If you turn out a light, you switch it off.

words.ex: He solves algebra problems every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天解代数题。
words.en: Algebra is a branch of mathematics in which letters and symbols are used to represent numbers and quantities in formulae and equations.

words.ex: He had an aneurysm in his brain.
words.ex_cn: 他的大脑里有一个动脉瘤。
words.en: An aneurysm is a bulge or ballooning in a blood vessel caused by weakness in the blood vessel wall.

words.tr: v. 断言；宣称；坚持；维护
words.ex: He asserts that the answer is correct.
words.ex_cn: 他坚持认为答案是正确的。
words.en: To state a fact or belief confidently and forcefully.

words.tr: n. 屁眼儿，肛门；令人讨厌的人; adj. 愚蠢的；窝囊的；可恶的
words.ex: He hurt his asshole after falling on a hard chair.
words.ex_cn: 他从硬椅子上摔下来后，屁股眼儿受伤了。
words.en: An asshole is a vulgar term for someone who is considered to be rude, inconsiderate, or contemptible.

words.ex: I am awaiting the bus.
words.ex_cn: 我正在等公交车。
words.en: If you await someone or something, you wait for them.

words.ex: The tourists were awe-struck by the grandeur of the ancient temple.
words.ex_cn: 游客们被这座古老寺庙的宏伟所震撼。
words.en: If you are awe-struck by something, you are extremely impressed and amazed by it, often to the point of feeling overwhelmed.

words.tr: adj. 无数的；多的；数不清的；
words.ex: There are countless stars in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 夜空中有无数颗星星。
words.en: Too numerous to count.

words.ex: The children play in the courtyard after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后在庭院里玩耍。
words.en: An open area surrounded by buildings or walls, often found in the center of a complex or building.

words.tr: v. 觊觎；垂涎；贪图；“covet”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: He coveted his neighbor's new car.
words.ex_cn: 他觊觎邻居的新车。
words.en: If you covet something, you have a very strong desire to possess it, often something that belongs to someone else.

words.tr:
n. 裂缝；噼啪声；
v. 破裂；
words.ex: There is a small crack in the wall.
words.ex_cn: 墙上有一条小裂缝。
words.en: If something hard cracks, or if you crack it, it becomes slightly damaged, with lines appearing on its surface.

words.ex: This painting has a distinctive style.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画有独特的风格。
words.en: Something that is distinctive has a special quality or feature which makes it easily recognizable and different from other things of the same type.

words.tr:
adj. 动态的；有活力的；不断变化的；
n. 活力；动力；
words.ex: The game has dynamic weather that changes every hour.
words.ex_cn: 这个游戏有每小时变化的动态天气。
words.en: If you describe someone as dynamic, you approve of them because they are full of energy or full of new ideas.

words.ex: He is exceptionally good at math.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学方面异常出色。
words.en: To an unusual degree; extremely.

words.tr:
n. 交换；兑换；交易所；
v. 交换；
words.ex: They made an exchange of books.
words.ex_cn: 他们进行了书籍的交换。
words.en: If you exchange something, you give it to someone and receive something else in return.

words.ex: He joins extracurricular activities after school.
words.ex_cn: 他放学后参加课外活动。
words.en: Extracurricular activities are those that fall outside the realm of the normal curriculum of school or university education, performed by students. Extracurricular activities exist at all levels of education, from 4th-6th, junior high/high school, college and university education.

words.tr: adj. 短暂的； v. “fleet”的现在分词；
words.ex: The smile was fleeting.
words.ex_cn: 那个微笑是短暂的。
words.en: If you describe something as fleeting, you mean that it lasts only for a very short time.

words.ex: He flipped the pancake with a spatula.
words.ex_cn: 他用铲子快速翻转了煎饼。
words.en: To flip something means to turn it over quickly one or more times, or to make something do this.

words.tr: adj. 即将开始的；新任的；
words.ex: The incoming class will start next week.
words.ex_cn: 即将开始的班级将在下周开课。
words.en: An incoming thing or person is arriving or being received.

words.ex: He did an internship at a hospital last summer.
words.ex_cn: 去年夏天，他在一家医院实习。
words.en: An internship is a period of work experience offered by an organization for a limited period of time. It is typically undertaken by students and graduates looking to gain relevant skills and experience in a particular field.

words.tr: adj. 人与人之间的；人际关系的；
words.ex: Good interpersonal skills help people work together.
words.ex_cn: 良好的人际交往能力有助于人们合作。
words.en: relating to relationships or communication between people

words.ex: The graph shows a linear relationship between time and distance.
words.ex_cn: 这张图显示了时间与距离之间的线性关系。
words.en: Linear means involving or relating to a straight line or lines.

words.ex: They have mutual respect for each other.
words.ex_cn: 他们彼此相互尊重。
words.en: Mutual is used to describe a situation, feeling, or action that is experienced, felt, or done by each of two or more parties towards the other or others.

words.ex: It was raining; nevertheless, we went for a walk.
words.ex_cn: 天下雨了；尽管如此，我们还是去散步了。
words.en: Despite what has just been said or done; nonetheless.

words.tr:
n. 谷歌（网络搜索引擎）；
vt. 用搜索引擎搜索（尤指用谷歌搜索引擎）；
words.ex: I use Google to find information online.
words.ex_cn: 我使用谷歌在网上查找信息。
words.en: To use the Google search engine to find information on the internet.

words.tr: n. 匾额；饰板；薄金属板；齿菌斑
words.ex: The plaque on the wall honors the founder of the school.
words.ex_cn: 墙上的匾额纪念这所学校的创始人。
words.en: A plaque is a flat piece of metal or stone with writing on it that is fixed to a wall or other structure to remind people of an important person or event.

words.tr: n. 预备新生（即将进入大学但尚未正式入学的新生）
words.ex: The prefrosh were excited to explore the campus during the orientation week.
words.ex_cn: 预备新生们在迎新周兴奋地探索校园。
words.en: A prefrosh is a student who has been accepted to a college or university but has not yet begun their studies.

words.tr: adj. 享有声望的；声望很高的；
words.ex: He got into a prestigious university.
words.ex_cn: 他进入了一所享有声望的大学。
words.en: A prestigious institution, job, or activity is respected and admired because it is considered to be of very high quality.

words.ex: The proximate cause of the accident was bad weather.
words.ex_cn: 事故的直接原因是恶劣天气。
words.en: If something is proximate, it is nearest in space, time, or relationship.

words.tr: vt. 重新校准，再校准；重校准
words.ex: The engineer had to recalibrate the instrument before taking measurements.
words.ex_cn: 工程师在测量之前不得不重新校准仪器。
words.en: To recalibrate something means to adjust or correct it again, especially a measuring device or system, so that it functions accurately.

words.tr:
v. 使脱落；去除；
n. 棚屋；
words.ex: The tree sheds its leaves in autumn.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树在秋天落叶。
words.en: A shed is a small building, usually made of wood, used for storing things such as garden tools. When something sheds, it loses its covering, such as leaves or hair, or it gets rid of something it no longer needs.

words.ex: He works as a teacher but his sideline is selling handmade crafts.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名教师，但他的副业是卖手工制品。
words.en: A sideline is an activity that you do in addition to your main job in order to earn extra money.

words.tr:
n. 一摞；一叠；一堆；大烟囱；
v. 把…放成整齐的一摞；
words.ex: He put the books in a stack on the table.
words.ex_cn: 他把书堆成一摞放在桌子上。
words.en: A stack is a pile of things, usually arranged one on top of another.

words.tr: adj. 紧张的；不自然的； v. “strain”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: His voice sounded strained during the phone call.
words.ex_cn: 他在电话里的声音听起来很紧张。
words.en: If a situation or relationship is strained, it is not relaxed or friendly, often because there is a problem or disagreement.

words.ex: I asked the school for a transcript of my grades.
words.ex_cn: 我向学校要了一份成绩单的副本。
words.en: A transcript is a written or printed version of something that has been recorded or spoken, especially in the context of academic records.

words.ex: The mistake was trivial and didn't affect the result.
words.ex_cn: 这个错误不重要，没有影响结果。
words.en: If you describe something as trivial, you mean that it is not important or significant, or is not worth serious consideration.

words.tr:
v. 力劝；
n. 强烈欲望；
words.ex: My teacher urged me to study harder.
words.ex_cn: 我的老师力劝我更加努力学习。
words.en: If you urge someone to do something, you try hard to persuade them to do it.

words.ex: They vie for the top prize.
words.ex_cn: 他们争夺最高奖项。
words.en: To compete eagerly with someone in order to do or achieve something.

words.tr: adj. 扭曲的；弯曲的；复杂的
words.ex: The twistful road made driving difficult.
words.ex_cn: 这条弯曲的道路让驾驶变得困难。
words.en: Characterized by twists or turns; winding.

words.tr: phrase. 坚持自己的权利或意见；表现自信；维护自我
words.ex: He finally decided to assert himself at work.
words.ex_cn: 他终于决定在工作中表现自己。
words.en: To behave or speak in a confident and forceful way, especially in order to make sure that one's own rights or opinions are respected.

words.tr: phrase. 被卷入；陷入（某种情况或情绪中）
words.ex: He was caught up in the excitement of the game.
words.ex_cn: v. 他被比赛的热情所吸引。
words.en: To become involved in something, often without intending to.

words.tr: phrase. 打碎；分裂；解体；结束；期终放假
words.ex: He broke up the ice with a hammer.
words.ex_cn: 他用锤子把冰打碎了。
words.en: To end a relationship or to disintegrate into pieces.

words.ex: He will embark on a new journey next month.
words.ex_cn: 他下个月将开始一段新的旅程。
words.en: To start or begin something, especially something new, challenging, or exciting.

words.tr: phrase. v. 快速翻阅；浏览
words.ex: He flips through the book quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他快速地翻阅这本书。
words.en: To quickly turn the pages of a book, magazine, etc., especially without reading everything.

words.ex: He got over his cold last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周康复了。
words.en: To recover from something, such as an illness or a shock; to overcome a problem or difficulty.

words.tr: phrase. 仔细想；考虑；反思；带来不良影响
words.ex: He likes to reflect on his day before sleep.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在睡觉前反思自己的一天。
words.en: If you reflect on something, you think deeply about it.

words.ex: He is an astute businessman who always makes smart decisions.
words.ex_cn: 他是个精明的商人，总是做出明智的决定。
words.en: If you describe someone as astute, you think they are clever and can see through things quickly and make good judgments.

words.ex: He abandoned his car in the snow.
words.ex_cn: 他把车抛弃在雪地里。
words.en: If you abandon a place, thing, or person, you leave the place, thing, or person permanently or for a long time, especially when you should not do so.

words.ex: He has the ability to solve math problems quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他有能力快速解决数学问题。
words.en: The capacity to do something or the possession of the means or skill to do something.

words.ex: He worked hard to accomplish his goal.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以实现自己的目标。
words.en: To accomplish something means to succeed in doing it, especially after a lot of effort.

words.ex: The government took quick action to fix the problem.
words.ex_cn: 政府迅速采取行动解决问题。
words.en: The fact or process of doing something, typically to achieve an aim.

words.tr: n. 替代选择；替代选择（alternative 的复数）；
words.ex: We need to find better alternatives to plastic.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要找到比塑料更好的替代选择。
words.en: An alternative is something that you can choose to do or use instead of something else.

words.ex: He gave me his assurance that the work would be done on time.
words.ex_cn: 他向我保证工作会按时完成。
words.en: If you give someone an assurance that something is true or will happen, you say that it is definitely true or will definitely happen, in order to make them feel less worried.

words.ex: The clarity of her explanation helped everyone understand.
words.ex_cn: 她解释的清晰帮助了每个人理解。
words.en: Clarity is the quality of being clear, in particular the quality of being easy to understand or see.

words.ex: You must concentrate on your homework.
words.ex_cn: 你必须集中精力做作业。
words.en: If you concentrate on something, you give it your full attention and think about it carefully.

words.ex: He showed conformity with the group's rules.
words.ex_cn: 他遵守了小组的规定。
words.en: Conformity is the act of matching attitudes, beliefs, and behaviors to group norms or standards.

words.ex: He must confront his fears.
words.ex_cn: 他必须面对自己的恐惧。
words.en: If you confront a difficult situation or issue, you accept the fact that it exists and try to deal with it.

words.ex: He received criticism for being late.
words.ex_cn: 他因为迟到而受到批评。
words.en: Criticism is the act of expressing disapproval of someone or something and of the faults they have or the mistakes they have made.

words.ex: He dwells in a small house near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 他住在湖边的一所小房子里。
words.en: If you dwell on something, especially something unpleasant, you think, speak, or write about it a lot or for quite a long time.

words.ex: Exercise can elevate your mood.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼可以提升你的情绪。
words.en: To elevate something means to raise it to a higher position or level, either physically or in terms of its status or importance.

words.ex: It is evident that he is tired.
words.ex_cn: 很明显他很累。
words.en: If something is evident, it is easy to see, perceive, or understand.

words.tr:
v. 集中；聚焦；
n. 中心点；焦点；
words.ex: He needs to focus on his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他需要集中精力做作业。
words.en: If you focus on a particular topic or if your attention is focused on it, you concentrate on it and think about it, discuss it, or deal with it, rather than dealing with other topics.

words.ex: He is a genius in math.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学方面是个天才。
words.en: Someone who is a genius is a person who is exceptionally intelligent or talented, especially in a particular field.

words.ex: This is a genuine diamond.
words.ex_cn: 这是一颗真正的钻石。
words.en: If something is genuine, it is real and exactly what it appears to be.

words.tr:
n. 影响（力）；
v. 影响；
words.ex: The teacher had a big influence on her students.
words.ex_cn: 老师对学生们有很大的影响。
words.en: The power to affect, control, or manipulate someone or something.

words.ex: He shows high intelligence in solving math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他在解决数学问题时表现出很高的智力。
words.en: The ability to acquire and apply knowledge and skills.

words.tr: v. 互相作用；互相影响；交流；沟通；
words.ex: The two chemicals interact when mixed.
words.ex_cn: 这两种化学物质混合时会互相作用。
words.en: If people interact with each other, they communicate or work together.

words.ex: His judgment was clear and fair.
words.ex_cn: 他的判断清晰而公正。
words.en: A judgment is an opinion that you have or express after thinking carefully about something.

words.ex: He overcame his fear of speaking in public.
words.ex_cn: 他克服了当众演讲的恐惧。
words.en: If you overcome a problem or a feeling, you successfully deal with it and control it.

words.ex: His persistence helped him pass the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他的坚持让他通过了考试。
words.en: Persistence is the determination to do something even though it is difficult or other people are against it.

words.ex: He has a positive attitude toward life.
words.ex_cn: 他对生活持积极的态度。
words.en: If you are positive about things, you are hopeful and confident, and think of the good aspects of a situation rather than the bad ones.

words.ex: He possesses a small house near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 他拥有一栋靠近湖边的小房子。
words.en: If you possess something, you have it or own it.

words.ex: She tried to prevail on him to change his mind.
words.ex_cn: 她试图劝服他改变主意。
words.en: If a proposal, principle, or opinion prevails, it gains influence or is accepted, often after a struggle or argument.

words.ex: He keeps his diary private.
words.ex_cn: 他把日记保密。
words.en: If something is private, it is for the use of one person or group, rather than for the general public.

words.ex: We need to plan realistically about the budget.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要实际地规划预算。
words.en: In a way that shows a sensible and practical idea of what can be achieved or expected.

words.ex: We can utilize solar energy to power the house.
words.ex_cn: 我们可以利用太阳能来为房子供电。
words.en: To utilize something means to use it in a practical or effective way.

words.tr:
n. 见解；风景；视野；
v. 观看；审视；
words.ex: His view on education is very different from mine.
words.ex_cn: 他对教育的见解与我的非常不同。
words.en: Your view of a particular subject is the way that you understand and think about it.

words.ex: His viewpoint is different from mine.
words.ex_cn: 他的观点与我的不同。
words.en: A viewpoint is a particular way of thinking about something, especially one that is influenced by your experiences or beliefs.

words.tr: phrase. 苏醒；到达；总计；突然想起
words.ex: He came to after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故后他醒了过来。
words.en: If someone comes to, they regain consciousness after being unconscious. It can also mean to reach a particular state or condition, or to be involved in something.

words.tr: phrase. 集中于； 专心于
words.ex: He must concentrate on his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他必须专心做作业。
words.en: To direct all your attention and effort towards a particular activity, subject, or problem.

words.ex: He depends on his brother for help.
words.ex_cn: 他依靠他哥哥帮忙。
words.en: To rely on someone or something for support, help, or supply; to be determined or influenced by something.

words.tr: phrase. v. 老是想着；过分关注（某事）； dwelling on 指反复思考或谈论不愉快的事
words.ex: He doesn't dwell on his mistakes.
words.ex_cn: 他不会纠结于自己的错误。
words.en: If you dwell on something, especially something unpleasant, you think, speak, or write about it a lot or for quite a long time.

words.tr: phrase. 集中（精力；注意力等）于
words.ex: He focuses on his homework every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上专心做作业。
words.en: to direct your attention or effort towards something specific

words.tr: phrase. 想到；想起；有...的看法
words.ex: I think of my mom when I eat cookies.
words.ex_cn: 当我吃饼干时，我想起我的妈妈。
words.en: To have a particular idea or opinion about something or someone; to consider something or someone in a particular way.

words.ex: I trust in your ability to solve this problem.
words.ex_cn: 我相信你有能力解决这个问题。
words.en: To have confidence in someone or something; to believe in their reliability, truth, ability, or strength.

words.ex: Don't worry about the test. You will do well.
words.ex_cn: 别担心考试，你会考好的。
words.en: To feel anxious or concerned about something or someone.

words.ex: He went abroad to study medicine.
words.ex_cn: 他去国外学医。
words.en: In or to a foreign country or countries.

words.tr: n. 住处；膳宿；(交通工具内的)空间；
words.ex: The hotel provided cheap accommodation for travelers.
words.ex_cn: 酒店为旅客提供了便宜的住处。
words.en: Accommodation is a place where someone lives or stays, or the act of providing someone with a place to live or stay.

words.tr: n. 优势；有利条件；好处；
words.ex: His height gives him an advantage in basketball.
words.ex_cn: 他的身高在篮球中给了他优势。
words.en: An advantage is a factor or circumstance that puts you in a favorable or superior position.

words.ex: One aspect of learning English is practicing speaking.
words.ex_cn: 学习英语的一个方面是练习口语。
words.en: An aspect of something is one of the parts of its character or nature.

words.ex: This car is economical because it uses little fuel.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车很经济，因为它耗油少。
words.en: Using money, resources, or time in a careful and effective way.

words.ex: He found employment after graduating from university.
words.ex_cn: 他大学毕业后找到了工作。
words.en: the condition of having paid work

words.ex: The expense of the trip was higher than expected.
words.ex_cn: 这次旅行的费用比预期的要高。
words.en: An expense is the amount of money that you spend on something.

words.ex: They explore the forest to find hidden caves.
words.ex_cn: 他们探索森林以寻找隐藏的洞穴。
words.en: To explore means to travel over or through an unfamiliar area in order to learn about it or to search for something valuable.

words.ex: He sent the document by fax.
words.ex_cn: 他通过传真发送了文件。
words.en: A fax is a machine that sends and receives documents electronically along a telephone line, or a document that is sent or received using such a machine.

words.ex: He hesitates to ask for help.
words.ex_cn: 他犹豫着是否要寻求帮助。
words.en: If you hesitate, you pause slightly while you are doing something or just before you do it, usually because you are uncertain, embarrassed, or worried.

words.ex: The police opened an inquiry into the accident.
words.ex_cn: 警方对这起事故展开了调查。
words.en: An inquiry is a question which you ask in order to get some information.

words.ex: He bought insurance for his car.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的车买了保险。
words.en: Insurance is an arrangement in which you pay money to a company, and they pay money to you if something unpleasant happens to you, for example if your property is stolen or damaged, or if you get a serious illness.

words.ex: I intend to go to the park tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我打算明天去公园。
words.en: If you intend to do something, you have decided or planned to do it.

words.tr: vt. 使国际化；置于国际管理下
words.ex: The company decided to internationalize its operations.
words.ex_cn: 公司决定将其业务国际化。
words.en: To make something international in scope or character.

words.ex: The police will investigate the accident.
words.ex_cn: 警方将调查这起事故。
words.en: If someone, especially an official, investigates an event, situation, or claim, they try to find out what happened or what is the truth.

words.ex: He got an opportunity to work abroad.
words.ex_cn: 他得到了一个去国外工作的机会。
words.en: An opportunity is a situation in which it is possible for you to do something that you want to do.

words.tr: n. 入学介绍；岗前训练；方向；取向；
words.ex: The school held an orientation for new students on Monday.
words.ex_cn: 学校在周一为新生举行了入学介绍。
words.en: The act of orienting or the state of being oriented; the determination of the relative position of something or someone (especially oneself).

words.ex: He will participate in the school play.
words.ex_cn: 他将参与学校的戏剧演出。
words.en: To take part in an activity or event.

words.tr: n. 付薪水的支票；薪水
words.ex: He gets his paycheck every Friday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周五领工资。
words.en: A paycheck is a check that an employee receives from their employer as payment for their work.

words.ex: The clock strikes precisely at noon.
words.ex_cn: 钟恰好在正午敲响。
words.en: In a precise manner; exactly.

words.ex: I recommend this book to you.
words.ex_cn: 我向你推荐这本书。
words.en: If someone recommends a person or thing to you, they suggest that you would find them good or useful.

words.tr: v. 租借；出租；“rend”的过去式和过去分词； n. 租金；
words.ex: They rent a small apartment in the city.
words.ex_cn: 他们租了一间城市里的小公寓。
words.en: Rent refers to the payment made periodically by a tenant to a landlord for the use of property or land.

words.ex: After a short break, he resumed his work.
words.ex_cn: 短暂休息后，他继续工作。
words.en: If you resume an activity or if it resumes, it begins again or continues after an interruption.

words.ex: The loud noise scared the child.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的噪音吓到了孩子。
words.en: If something scares you, it frightens or worries you.

words.tr:
n. 税；税款；
v. 对...征税；
words.ex: He pays tax every year.
words.ex_cn: 他每年缴税。
words.en: A tax is a sum of money that you have to pay to the government so that it can pay for public services.

words.ex: I truly appreciate your help.
words.ex_cn: 我衷心感谢你的帮助。
words.en: You use truly to emphasize that something has all the features or qualities of a particular thing, or is the case to the fullest possible extent.

words.ex: He will undertake a new project next month.
words.ex_cn: 他下个月将从事一个新项目。
words.en: To undertake a task or job means to start doing it and accept responsibility for it.

words.ex: He needs a visa to travel to Japan.
words.ex_cn: 他需要一张签证去日本旅行。
words.en: A visa is an official document, or a stamp put in your passport, which allows you to enter or leave a particular country.

words.tr: n. 劳动力；工人总数；职工总数；
words.ex: The factory needs a larger workforce to meet demand.
words.ex_cn: 工厂需要更多的劳动力来满足需求。
words.en: The workforce is the total number of people who are employed by a particular company or who are available to work in a particular country or area.

words.ex: He didn't study hard, as a result, he failed the test.
words.ex_cn: 他没有努力学习，结果考试不及格。
words.en: used to introduce the consequence or effect of a particular situation or event

words.tr: phrase. 避免；绕开；说服；顺利应付
words.ex: He tried to get around the rules by using a loophole.
words.ex_cn: 他试图利用一个漏洞来规避规则。
words.en: To find a way to deal with or avoid a problem; to move or travel from place to place; to become known by many people.

words.ex: He wants to participate in the school play.
words.ex_cn: 他想参加学校的戏剧表演。
words.en: To take part in an activity or event.

words.tr: phrase. （供应、资源等）减少；即将耗尽；快要用完
words.ex: The car runs low on fuel during the trip.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在旅途中燃料快用完了。
words.en: If something is running low, there is not much of it left.

words.ex: So far, he has finished his homework.
words.ex_cn: 到目前为止，他已经完成了作业。
words.en: Up to the present moment; until now.

words.ex: He waited with anticipation for the results.
words.ex_cn: 他怀着期待等待结果。
words.en: Anticipation is a feeling of excitement about something pleasant or exciting that you know is going to happen.

words.ex: He gave an anticipatory smile before the surprise.
words.ex_cn: 他在惊喜到来前露出了预期的微笑。
words.en: If you describe something as anticipatory, you mean that it is characterized by anticipation. It involves expecting or looking forward to something with a feeling of excitement or anxiety.

words.tr: n. 共同执笔者；合著者；
words.ex: He is the coauthor of the science book.
words.ex_cn: 他是这本科学书籍的共同执笔者。
words.en: A coauthor is a person who works with another person or other people to write a book, article, or report.

words.tr:
n. 硬币；金属钱币；
v. 创造；
words.ex: He has a coin in his pocket.
words.ex_cn: 他口袋里有一枚硬币。
words.en: A coin is a small, flat, round piece of metal or plastic that is used as money.

words.ex: The concept of freedom is important in many countries.
words.ex_cn: 自由这个观念在许多国家都很重要。
words.en: A concept is an idea or abstract principle.

words.ex: He was conscious after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故后他醒了过来。
words.en: If you are conscious of something, you notice it or are aware of it.

words.ex: The continuity of the story made it easy to follow.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事的连续性让它容易理解。
words.en: Continuity is the fact that something continues to happen or exist, with no great changes or interruptions.

words.ex: The new phone is too costly for me.
words.ex_cn: 这部新手机对我来说太贵了。
words.en: If you say that something is costly, you mean that it costs a lot of money, often more than you would want to pay.

words.tr:
v. 计算；看作；清点；
n. 计数；计算；
words.ex: He counts the apples on the table.
words.ex_cn: 他计算桌子上的苹果数量。
words.en: To determine the total number of a collection of items.

words.ex: Exercise can enhance your health.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼可以提高你的健康。
words.en: To enhance something means to improve its value, quality, or attractiveness.

words.tr: adj. 必需的；基本的；本质的；
words.ex: Water is essential for life.
words.ex_cn: 水对生命是必需的。
words.en: Something that is essential is extremely important or absolutely necessary to a particular subject, situation, or activity.

words.ex: He is an extroverted boy who loves talking to new people.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个外向的男孩，喜欢和新人交谈。
words.en: Someone who is extroverted is very active, lively, and sociable.

words.tr: v. 完成；满足；“fulfill”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 满足的；
words.ex: He fulfilled his promise to help.
words.ex_cn: 他履行了帮助的承诺。
words.en: If you feel fulfilled, you feel happy and satisfied because you are doing something that fully uses your abilities and qualities.

words.ex: He showed his identity card to enter the building.
words.ex_cn: 他出示了身份证以进入大楼。
words.en: Your identity is who you are, or the qualities of a person or group that make them different from others.

words.ex: He is an introverted boy who likes reading alone.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个喜欢独自读书的内向男孩。
words.en: An introverted person is someone who tends to be more focused on their own thoughts and feelings rather than on external things or other people.

words.tr: v. 使增加至最大限度；最大化；
words.ex: He tries to maximize his profit by selling more.
words.ex_cn: 他通过多卖东西来使利润达到最大。
words.en: To maximize something means to make it as great in amount, size, or importance as possible.

words.ex: He felt nostalgia when he saw his old toy.
words.ex_cn: 当他看到自己的旧玩具时，感到怀旧。
words.en: A sentimental longing or wistful affection for the past, typically for a period or place with happy personal associations.

words.ex: He is optimistic about the future.
words.ex_cn: 他对未来持乐观态度。
words.en: Someone who is optimistic is hopeful about the future or the success of something in particular.

words.ex: His outlook on life is very positive.
words.ex_cn: 他对生活的观点非常积极。
words.en: Your outlook is your general attitude towards life.

words.tr:
adj. 总的；全面的；总体的；
adv. 总计；大致上；
words.ex: The overall cost is too high.
words.ex_cn: 总成本太高了。
words.en: You use overall to indicate that you are talking about a situation in general or about the whole of something.

words.ex: His perception of the sound was very sharp.
words.ex_cn: 他对声音的感知非常敏锐。
words.en: Your perception of something is the way that you think about it or the impression you have of it.

words.ex: His personality is very friendly and outgoing.
words.ex_cn: 他的个性非常友好和外向。
words.en: The combination of characteristics or qualities that form an individual's distinctive character.

words.tr: adj. 令人愉快的；愉悦的；
words.ex: The trip was a pleasurable experience.
words.ex_cn: 这次旅行是一次令人愉快的经历。
words.en: Something that is pleasurable is enjoyable or gives you pleasure.

words.ex: He sat by the window to ponder his future.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在窗边深思自己的未来。
words.en: If you ponder something, you think about it carefully.

words.ex: He wants to study psychology at university.
words.ex_cn: 他想在大学学习心理学。
words.en: Psychology is the scientific study of the human mind and the reasons for people's behaviour.

words.tr: v. 使社会化；进行社交活动；与人交往
words.ex: The school helps children socialize with others.
words.ex_cn: 学校帮助孩子们与他人社会化。
words.en: If you socialize, you meet other people socially, for example at parties.

words.ex: The texture of the bread is soft and fluffy.
words.ex_cn: 这种面包的质地柔软蓬松。
words.en: The feel, appearance, or consistency of a surface or a substance.

words.ex: He gave a verbal warning instead of a written one.
words.ex_cn: 他给了一个口头警告，而不是书面的。
words.en: Relating to or in the form of words.

words.tr:
n. 渴望；向往
adj. 渴望的；向往的
v. 渴望；渴求；“yearn”的现在分词
words.ex: He has a yearning for home.
words.ex_cn: 他渴望回家。
words.en: A yearning is a strong feeling of wanting something, especially something that you know you may not be able to have.

words.tr: phrase. 继续；坚持；进行；开展
words.ex: He will carry on working after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午饭后会继续工作。
words.en: If you carry on, you continue doing something.

words.ex: He engages in sports after school.
words.ex_cn: 他放学后参加体育运动。
words.en: To participate or become involved in an activity.

words.tr: phrase. v. 参与某事；从事某事
words.ex: He engages in sports after school.
words.ex_cn: 他放学后参加体育活动。
words.en: To take part in or become involved in an activity.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 保持团结；维持稳定；使结合在一起
words.ex: The team must hold together to win the game.
words.ex_cn: 团队必须团结一致才能赢得比赛。
words.en: If something holds together, it remains whole or united and does not break or fall apart.

words.ex: He looks back on his childhood with happiness.
words.ex_cn: 他满怀幸福地回忆自己的童年。
words.en: To look back means to think about something that happened in the past.

words.ex: I like to look back on my childhood summers at the beach.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢回忆我在海滩上度过的童年夏天。
words.en: If you look back on a period of time, event, or situation, you think about it or remember it.

words.tr: phrase. 与某人联系；主动接触某人；向某人伸出援手
words.ex: Please reach out to me if you need help.
words.ex_cn: 如果你需要帮助，请联系我。
words.en: To make an effort to communicate with someone, especially in order to offer help or support.

words.tr: phrase. 倾向于做某事；往往会做某事
words.ex: People tend to do something when they feel stressed.
words.ex_cn: 当人们感到压力时，他们往往会做某事。
words.en: If someone or something tends to do a particular thing, they usually do it or they are likely to do it.

words.ex: He felt anxiety before the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试前感到忧虑。
words.en: Anxiety is a feeling of worry, nervousness, or unease about something with an uncertain outcome.

words.tr:
n. 碰撞；坠毁；崩溃；
v. 碰撞；坠毁；崩溃；
words.ex: The car crash happened at the intersection.
words.ex_cn: 汽车碰撞发生在十字路口。
words.en: If a vehicle crashes or if the driver crashes it, it hits something and is damaged or destroyed.

words.tr: v. 挤压；压碎；“crush”的现在分词；
words.ex: The machine is crushing the cans.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器正在挤压罐子。
words.en: If you describe something as crushing, you mean that it is very severe or intense.

words.ex: He felt deep depression after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业后感到深深的抑郁。
words.en: A period during which business, employment, and stock-market values decline severely or remain at a very low level of activity.

words.tr: n. 镇定剂，令人沮丧的人
words.ex: The news was a real downer for everyone.
words.ex_cn: 这个消息让所有人都感到沮丧。
words.en: A downer is something that makes you feel sad or depressed.

words.tr: adj. 尴尬的；窘迫的； v. “embarrass”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He felt embarrassed when he tripped in front of everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他在大家面前绊倒时感到很尴尬。
words.en: If you are embarrassed, you feel shy or ashamed because of something that you have done or that has happened to you.

words.ex: He waited for hours, and eventually got his turn.
words.ex_cn: 他等了几个小时，终于轮到他了。
words.en: At an unspecified later time; in the end.

words.ex: His expectation was to pass the test.
words.ex_cn: 他的期待是通过考试。
words.en: An expectation is a belief about what might happen in the future, especially about something that you think is likely or that you hope will happen.

words.ex: The external wall of the house is painted blue.
words.ex_cn: 房子的外墙被刷成了蓝色。
words.en: External is used to indicate that something is on the outside of a surface or body, or that it exists, happens, or comes from outside.

words.tr:
v. 想要；
adj. 花哨的；昂贵的；
n. 爱好；
words.ex: I fancy a cup of tea.
words.ex_cn: 我想要一杯茶。
words.en: If you describe something as fancy, you mean that it is special, unusual, or elaborate, often because it has a lot of decoration or is very expensive.

words.ex: The accident looked horrendous.
words.ex_cn: 那场事故看起来很可怕。
words.en: If you describe something as horrendous, you are emphasizing that it is very unpleasant or shocking.

words.ex: The landscape after the rain is very beautiful.
words.ex_cn: 雨后的景色非常美丽。
words.en: A landscape is all the visible features of an area of land, often considered in terms of their aesthetic appeal.

words.ex: He felt loneliness after moving to a new city.
words.ex_cn: 他搬到新城市后感到孤独。
words.en: Loneliness is the unhappiness that is felt by someone because they do not have any friends or do not have anyone to talk to.

words.ex: He works in marketing for a tech company.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家科技公司从事营销工作。
words.en: Marketing involves the process of promoting, selling, and distributing a product or service. It includes market research and advertising.

words.tr:
v. 呻吟；呼啸；抱怨
n. 呻吟声；萧萧声；抱怨
words.ex: He moans when he is tired.
words.ex_cn: 他累了的时候会呻吟。
words.en: If you moan, you make a low sound, usually because you are unhappy or in pain.

words.tr: v. 导航；应付（复杂情况）；
words.ex: He uses a map to navigate the city.
words.ex_cn: 他用地图来导航这座城市。
words.en: To navigate is to plan and direct the route or course of a ship, aircraft, or other form of transport, especially by using instruments or maps.

words.ex: I like fruits, particularly apples.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢水果，尤其是苹果。
words.en: Used to single out a subject to which a statement is especially applicable.

words.tr: adj. 尚可的；可通行的；（钱币等）可流通的
words.ex: The road was passable but not in good condition.
words.ex_cn: 这条路尚可通行，但状况不佳。
words.en: If something is passable, it is good enough to be accepted or allowed, but not of a very high standard.

words.ex: He permanently moved to Canada last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年永久搬到了加拿大。
words.en: In a way that continues or lasts forever without changing.

words.ex: The poll showed that most people support the new law.
words.ex_cn: 这项民意调查表明，大多数人支持这项新法律。
words.en: A poll is a survey in which people are asked their opinions about something, usually in order to find out how popular something is or what people intend to do in the future.

words.tr:
n. 邮件；职位；邮寄；帖子；柱；
v. 邮寄；张贴；
words.ex: I checked the post this morning.
words.ex_cn: 我今天早上检查了邮件。
words.en: To post something means to send it through the postal system or to display it publicly, such as on a noticeboard or the internet. It can also refer to the act of assigning someone to a particular job or position.

words.tr:
n. 潜力；
adj. 潜在的；
words.ex: The young athlete shows great potential.
words.ex_cn: 这位年轻运动员展现出巨大的潜力。
words.en: If you say that someone or something has potential, you mean that they have the necessary abilities or qualities to become successful or useful in the future.

words.tr: adj. 首要的；主要的；基本的；最好的；
words.ex: This is the prime reason for the delay.
words.ex_cn: 这是延误的首要原因。
words.en: Prime is used to describe something that is of the best possible quality, or the most important or basic part of something.

words.ex: He rarely eats fast food.
words.ex_cn: 他很少吃快餐。
words.en: Not often; seldom.

words.tr:
v. 狂欢作乐；陶醉；酷爱
n. 作乐；狂欢
words.ex: They reveled in the success of their new product.
words.ex_cn: 他们为新产品的成功而狂欢。
words.en: If you revel in something, you enjoy it very much.

words.tr: adj. 社会的；关于社会的；
words.ex: Social media affects societal behavior.
words.ex_cn: 社交媒体影响社会行为。
words.en: Relating to society or social relations.

words.ex: The bridge is stable and safe to cross.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥很稳固，可以安全通过。
words.en: If something is stable, it is not likely to change or come to an end suddenly.

words.ex: He felt the stigma of being unemployed.
words.ex_cn: 他感受到了失业的耻辱。
words.en: A stigma is a strong feeling of disapproval that most people in a society have about something, especially when this is unfair.

words.tr:
n. 目标；对象；
v. 以…为目标；
words.ex: His target is to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他的目标是按时完成项目。
words.en: A target is something at which someone is aiming a weapon or other object.

words.ex: The transition from school to work was hard for him.
words.ex_cn: 从学校到工作的转变对他来说很难。
words.en: The process or a period of changing from one state or condition to another.

words.tr:
adj. 未说出的；未表达的
v. 取消；撤回；’“unspeak”的过去分词
words.ex: There was an unspoken agreement between them.
words.ex_cn: 他们之间有一个未说出口的协议。
words.en: If something is unspoken, it has not been said, although it might have been thought or felt.

words.ex: He gave her a bunch of flowers.
words.ex_cn: 他送给她一束花。
words.en: A large number or quantity of something.

words.ex: He is at best a beginner in cooking.
words.ex_cn: 他在烹饪方面最多是个初学者。
words.en: At best is used to indicate the most positive or optimistic scenario or outcome, often implying that the actual situation may be worse.

words.ex: My friend always backs up my ideas in meetings.
words.ex_cn: 我的朋友总是在会议上支持我的想法。
words.en: To support someone or something; to make a copy of computer data to protect against loss.

words.tr: phrase. 贡献；促成；导致；有助于
words.ex: Volunteers contribute to the clean-up of the park.
words.ex_cn: 志愿者们为公园的清洁做出了贡献。
words.en: If you contribute to something, you help to cause it or make it happen.

words.ex: I feel like eating pizza tonight.
words.ex_cn: 我今晚想吃披萨。
words.en: To have a desire or inclination for something; to have a sensation or impression of being a certain way.

words.tr: phrase. 算出；弄明白；解决；想出
words.ex: I can't figure out the answer.
words.ex_cn: 我算不出答案。
words.en: To understand or solve something by thinking about it.

words.tr: phrase. 陶醉于；沉迷于；尽情享受；因…而兴高采烈
words.ex: They revel in the sunshine on the beach.
words.ex_cn: 他们尽情享受海滩上的阳光。
words.en: To take great pleasure or delight in something.

words.tr: phrase. （因压力过大而）感到焦虑或紧张；使自己过度紧张
words.ex: She was stressing out over the upcoming exam.
words.ex_cn: 她对即将到来的考试感到焦虑。
words.en: To cause someone to feel extremely anxious or worried.

words.tr:
n. 服务人员
adj. 随之而来的
words.ex: The attendant helped me find my seat.
words.ex_cn: 服务员帮我找到了座位。
words.en: An attendant is someone whose job is to serve or help people in a public place.

words.tr:
adj. 辅助的；附属的
n. 辅助物；附属物；助动词
words.ex: He used an auxiliary verb to form the past tense.
words.ex_cn: 他使用了一个助动词来构成过去时。
words.en: An auxiliary is a person or thing that provides additional help or support.

words.tr: n. （大学一年级男生或儿童等戴的）无檐小便帽
words.ex: He wears a beanie in winter.
words.ex_cn: 他冬天戴一顶毛线帽。
words.en: A beanie is a small, round, close-fitting hat, usually made of wool, that is worn on the head to keep it warm.

words.tr:
adj. 幸福的；受祝福的；神圣的
v. 祝福；保佑；“bless”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: She is blessed with a kind heart.
words.ex_cn: 她拥有一颗善良的心。
words.en: Made holy; consecrated.

words.ex: The farmer drove his cart full of apples to the market.
words.ex_cn: 农夫驾着装满苹果的运货马车去市场。
words.en: A cart is a vehicle with two or four wheels that is pulled by a horse or a person and is used for carrying goods.

words.tr: adj. 仁慈的；慈善事业的；
words.ex: She gave charitable donations to the poor.
words.ex_cn: 她向穷人捐赠了仁慈的善款。
words.en: A charitable organization or activity helps and supports people who are ill, very poor, or who have disabilities.

words.ex: The choir sings every Sunday in church.
words.ex_cn: 唱诗班每周日在教堂唱歌。
words.en: A choir is a group of people who sing together, especially in a church or school.

words.tr: adj. 恒定的；不变的；持续的；
words.ex: The temperature is constant in this room.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间的温度是恒定的。
words.en: Something that is constant happens all the time or is always there.
